README

Recorded documentation

Upstream documentation. Cargo examples describe the Rust crate; Add to project provides the Oven dependency.

README.md · Author-provided

inotify-sys crates.io Documentation Build Status

Low-level inotify bindings for the Rust programming language. This crate's main purpose is to serve as the base for inotify-rs, the idiomatic Rust wrapper around inotify. Unless you're sure you specifically need this crate, please use inotify-rs instead.

CHANGELOG.md · Author-provided

Changelog

v0.1.8 (2026-07-07)

  • Use native inotify on FreeBSD unconditionally (#32)

v0.1.7 (2026-07-02)

  • Add freebsd-native feature to bypass libnotify on FreeBSD (#26)

v0.1.6 (2026-07-01)

  • Add support for FreeBSD via libinotify (#25, #28)
  • Add IN_MASK_CREATE (#27)

v0.1.5 (2021-01-16)

  • Add LICENSE file (#21)

v0.1.4 (2020-11-06)

  • Fix build by no longer failing on warnings

v0.1.3 (2018-07-26)

Bug Fixes
  • Use platform-specific constants from libc (b363dff1)
